description: If finite subterm-closed \(S\) contains all terms of a ground equality problem and no disequation is in the computed closure, the specified quotient-plus-default structure satisfies that problem.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.model_satisfies.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (P : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.Problem L)
  (S : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L)) (hE : P.equations ⊆ S.product S)
  (hD : P.disequations ⊆ S.product S) (hS : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.SubtermClosed S)
  (hcheck : ∀ p ∈ P.disequations, p ∉ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.closure S P.equations) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.Satisfies P
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.Carrier S P.equations hE)
